messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: control-plane deps elevated 5xx observed (auth/org-lookup/config). Spike started ~3055554300. Paging oncall.
james: i'm on it, diving in. which API surface is seeing the 5xx? any customer reports yet?
anya: frontend alert shows increased 502/504 from /v1/users/* and /v1/auth/token. Gateway is returning 502 when caller service gets a 502 from org-lookup.
michael: seeing org-lookup latency spike to 2.5s and error rate ~18% from metrics. config-service also showing retries failing, looks like a small cascade.
dalia: customer-success called — a handful of customers in eu-west are reporting token creation failures. mark customer-impact:partial.
sara: setting severity=sev2. paging infra and auth owners. @james can you confirm if this is a rolling deploy or infra issue?
james: not aware of any deploys. checking control plane deploy logs now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: No deploys in the last 2 hours across control-plane clusters.
anya: quick mitigation idea: turn off org-lookup fanout to billing for a short window (failsafe path) and route to cached org metadata.
michael: agree. org-lookup is doing parallel calls to auth + billing + config, one noisy downstream (billing) is timing out and causing fanout to blow up.
james: i'm going to flip fallback routing in the gateway to use org-cache (stale ok) and increase billing downstream timeout from 500ms -> 1200ms temporarily.
dalia: pls announce to support channels before doing the config flip. customers may see increased stale org metadata.
sara: good call. @dalia, draft message for support.
dalia: draft: "We're seeing transient auth/org lookup errors that may affect token creation for a subset of EU customers. We're applying a temporary fallback to cached org metadata to restore API success rates — some org fields may be stale for ~5-10m. We'll update when fully mitigated." send? :thumbsup:
james: applying gateway routing change now.

```
# gateway canary patch
kubectl -n control-plane patch configmap gateway-routing --patch '{"data":{"org_lookup_mode":"cache_fallback"}}'
```

ops-bot: runbook: increased billing client timeout and enabled cache_fallback.

incident-bot: metric update: 5xx rate down from 14% -> 3.2% (1m) after routing change.
anya: nice, latency improved too. still seeing occasional timeouts from billing. would like to throttle fanout concurrency to billing to reduce retries.
michael: i'm going to adjust the org-lookup client to limit parallel requests to 2 for now and spike a circuit-breaker if error rate > 10%.
james: doing that via feature-flag toggle.

```
# feature toggle
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://controlplane.internal/v1/flags/org_lookup_concurrency -d '{"value":2}'
```

james: flag applied. monitoring.
ops-bot: note: created ticket CP-3245 to track rollback plan and post-incident actions.
dalia: support message posted.
sara: handoff: i'll own until next update, but @michael and @james please continue remediation. also loop in billing team if errors persist.
michael: digging into billing service logs — increased DB connection retries correlate with slow queries. opening a ticket to ops-db.

james: temporary mitigation summary for postmortem: 1) gateway routing -> cache_fallback 2) increase billing timeout 3) throttle fanout concurrency 4) enable circuit-breaker for billing calls.

incident-bot: customer-impact: partial, EU token flows affected for ~30m window; majority restored via fallback. No major data loss reported.
sara: preparing incident bridge notes and will start timeline. handoff to morning shift in 40m.
anya: a couple action items for postmortem: add org-lookup dependency map, add golden metrics for billing latency, test cache_fallback in staging.
dalia: closing loop with CS: customers notified and auto-retry guidance provided.

james: final metrics: 5xx rate back to baseline (~0.6%). will leave flag on for 30m before progressively reverting.
sara: thanks everyone. adding severity lower to monitoring-only in 60m if stable. create follow-up for DB slow query investigation.
ops-bot: incident closed by sara at 3055555130 (follow-ups: CP-3245, DB-ops-781).
